مَدْخَلٌ An entrance, i. e. a place of entrance, or ingress, (S, Msb,) of a house [or the like; and any inlet]. (Msb.) ―
-b2- [Hence,] (tropical:) A way of act-
ing. (K, TA: see دُخْلَةٌ, last sentence, in two places.) [And مَدْخَلُ خَيْرٍ (assumed tropical:) A means of attaining, or doing, good.] ―
-b3- [Also A time of entrance.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
